== 2026 Worlds ALT printing links ==

Connected [[Anakin's Destiny (ALT)]] to the complete existing Versions/Printings navigation. Its entry follows regular Virtual Modern and precedes Modern Errata; the current article is listed once. Card identities and GEMP aliases are unchanged.

The Set icon field records the symbols actually visible on this printing: Death Star II and virtual set 21. The virtual set number is kept with the publication symbols, separate from gameplay icons.

The historical image citation now uses an immutable primary repository URL. Its preserved image is the exact same binary recovered from the official resource host; the reference identifies that scope.
